verdict.rationale: Drive docs confirm organized shared folders with inherited permissions, view/comment/edit-only sharing roles, and even a documented script to 'populate a spreadsheet with file sharing info for audit,' which supports the founder's diligence-room use case. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a download/print/copy-blocking toggle for viewers, nor a built-in access-visibility dashboard beyond the DIY audit script. missing for 10: explicit download-restriction control documentation, native audit/access-log UI (not just a custom script), and any independent/community confirmation that this data-room workflow works well in practice.
